title: The Drama of Discrimination: Days, Deaths, Plagues, and Strongholds
summary: The cosmic drama of separation across nine teachings: the Three Days of life and the Two Deaths; the three eternal works at the consummation paired with the three plagues by which self-love is contained, refined, and sealed; the three dwellings of water, darkness, and fire stripped from the archons; the Father's pouring of the strongholds down to the earth and back up again; the Living Spirit's ascent and the three works of the sphere; the pre-fashioned containments of providence; the Lord's foresight setting every operation in advance of its crisis; and the star-wheel as the binding-engine that holds falsity in cyclic restraint.
organizing_principle: Sustained meditation on the discriminative work of regeneration. The teachings progress from the eschatological frame (days, deaths) through the stripping operations (plagues, dwellings) to providential foresight and finally to the bound astral mechanism — sorting truth from falsity at every cosmic level.
